change-language.description: Inspect text or stdin, tracked workspace files, commit messages, or task titles and bodies using the repository's bounded English-language rule. The tasks mode reads the configured tasks provider. Findings exit 1; invalid input or an unavailable provider exits 2.

label.description: With text: label the input in findings.

diff.description: With files: inspect tracked files changed in a revision range.

limit.description: With tasks: maximum number of task records to inspect.

change-verify.description: Check the local evidence of a build run against the worktree it runs in, and print one JSON verdict. --record verifies a dossier: its tree binding, changed files, policy files, consulted scopes, independent review, gate, qualification verdicts, acceptance evidence and an optional v1 workflow record. --workflow validates a separately versioned local workflow and reports progress without minting readiness. --snapshot prints the dossier skeleton for the current tree, --ref prints a file reference with its SHA-256, and --gate checks that a recorded gate session and report can replace the gate the PR finalizer would run. A gate must cover the native impacted plan, which the workspace CLI of the checked repository answers as a dry run. A restored verification report is read from the task cache of the putnami process that launched the command. Paths resolve against the Git top level. A failure prints {"verdict":"not-verified","reason":...} on one line and exits 1 with nothing on stderr; --output does not change the document. It is a consistency check, not a signed review or an access boundary, and it writes nothing.

record.description: Verify the dossier this file holds and print the verified verdict.

workflow.description: Validate a v1 local workflow and report progress without a ready verdict.

snapshot.description: Print the dossier skeleton for the current tree.

ref.description: Print the reference to this file: its path as given and its SHA-256.

gate.description: Check that the recorded gate session can replace the finalizer's gate.

base.description: Base revision; default origin/main for --snapshot and --gate, and for --record the base the dossier must name.

change-finalize.description: Publish a proposal through the collaboration contracts: a draft with --draft, or a clean committed change with current proof, either a dossier that change verify accepts (--verification-file) or the hosted checks the contributor policy names (--gate ci). It pushes the branch, writes the proposal, reads it back, and with a task delivers it, or with --partial-delivery keeps it open. It runs no local gate and never retries a write whose outcome is unknown. It reaches the providers, the workspace and the task cache through the putnami process that launched it. --output=json prints the result document; otherwise it prints PROPOSAL_REF and PROPOSAL_URL lines. A usage error exits 2 and a failure exits 1.

branch.description: Branch to publish; it must be the current branch.

title.description: Proposal title, in Conventional Commits form.

body-file.description: File that holds the proposal body, which becomes the squash message.

task-source.description: Source of the task the proposal delivers; give it with --task-id.

task-id.description: ID of the task the proposal delivers; give it with --task-source.

verification-file.description: Dossier that proves the committed change locally.

workflow-file.description: With --gate ci: the workflow record that decides whether the task completes.

gate.description: ci waits for the hosted checks the contributor policy names, instead of a dossier.

proof.description: Local proof to record in the verification review comment.

draft.description: Publish a draft; a branch with no commit gets a title-only empty commit.

partial-delivery.description: Deliver one unit of the task: refer to the task without closing it, and leave it open.
